data.one_liner: Fast native image resize, crop, and compression for Flutter using FFI.
data.what_it_does: Decodes, resizes, crops, and encodes images via a native C pipeline using bicubic interpolation. It supports JPEG, PNG, raw buffers, and ML tensor preprocessing with automatic batching and EXIF orientation handling.
use_when: You need high-performance image resizing, cropping, or compression that avoids heavy Dart processing.
You are preparing image inputs for machine learning models (like TensorFlow Lite or PyTorch) with custom normalization and tensor layouts.
You need to process batches of images in parallel across isolates with progress reporting.
avoid_when: You need a UI widget that automatically loads and displays network images with caching.
You require complex image manipulation features not covered by basic resizing, cropping, compression, and format conversion.
strengths: Native C performance via ffi provides fast execution times.
Comprehensive ML preprocessing features including tensor normalization and presets for common models.
Built-in batch processing with isolate concurrency control and progress tracking.
weaknesses: Limited to JPEG, PNG, and raw RGB/RGBA byte formats.
Does not include higher-level UI widgets for rendering or interactive cropping.
data.setup_notes: Zero external Dart dependencies other than ffi; compiled native C code runs out of the box on supported platforms.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a pure Dart image processing library with a broad array of image manipulation filters and encoders that doesn't rely on native FFI compilation.

alternatives.name: flutter_image_compress
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need optimized native compression for files on Android and iOS without advanced ML tensor conversions.
